Deep in the {wiki:Thais Dragon Lair|Thais Dragon Lair}, full of dragons, a treasure is hidden. Cross the maze of caves north of Alatar Lake, break a rock with a {item:Pick} and go through the level 40 door to find the chest with the {item:Naginata}.
Deep inside a place full of dragons, a treasure is hidden...
to break the rock covering the hole
Bring fire protection and potions: there are lots of {creature:Dragon|Dragons} and some {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords}.
{creature:Cyclops|Cyclopes} lured by other players may show up.
The 2 Dragon Lords in the final room take a long time to respawn: if someone has killed them recently, the way is clear.
1. The way to the dragon lair

Enter the cave **north** of {wiki:Alatar Lake|Alatar Lake}. The lake is **northeast of Thais** ({coord:32393,32118,7}): leave the city on foot and head northeast to the lake; the cave entrance is north of it ({coord:32357,32085,7}).
At the start there are {creature:Snake|Snakes}, {creature:Spider|Spiders}, {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms} and {creature:Carrion Worm|Carrion Worms}.
Follow the passage **southeast** and go down one more floor.
Continue **south** and then **east**. Go up the stairs.
Map 2: south, east and stairs up
Follow this short passage **southwest** and go down **two** floors.
Going around to the south and up
Follow this passage, going around to the **south**, and go up.
Map 4: going around to the south and up
Go straight **west** and go down one floor.
Follow the passage **north** and go down again.
Going up to the dragon lair
In this room, go up one floor to enter the dragon lair (the {wiki:Thais Dragon Lair|Thais Dragon Lair}, 3 floors below ground).
Map 6b: climb to the dragon lair
If you own the {wiki:Dark Mansion} house, the dragon lair has easy access from its cellar.
In the dragon lair you will have {creature:Dragon|Dragons} coming from every direction, and one or two {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} at the far **north** end of the room.
Dragons and Dragon Lords breathe fire in an area. Do not let them surround you.
Breaking the rock with the Pick
Go to the small room to the **north**. There is a big rock over a hole: use the {item:Pick} on the rock until it breaks and go down through the hole.
The rock over the hole, in the room north of the dragon lair
You lose hit points while you break the rock: have full health before you start.
On the other side of the level 40 {item:Door of Expertise} there is another hole. Go down through it: down there you find **2** {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} (they respawn very slowly).
Two Dragon Lords at the same time are dangerous for levels 40–50. Go carefully or bring company.
The reward is in a chest at the far **north** end of this room. Open it to receive the {item:Naginata}.

There is no shortcut out: go back the same way. Use the {item:Rope} to climb up the two holes (the one in the Dragon Lords room and the one in the rock you broke), cross the dragon lair again and follow the maps in reverse back to the cave north of Alatar Lake ({coord:32357,32085,7}). Then walk back southwest to Thais.
The {creature:Dragon Lord} near the centre of the lair respawns very fast: keep your health high on the way back.
